## Approved Spec
`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-01-todo-due-date-design.md`

# Design: Due date for todos (ticket #1)

Ticket: Gitea `adw/demo-todo` #1 "Fälligkeitsdatum für Todos" — todos get a due date so
overdue items are visible in the API and in the list.

## Intent
A todo can carry an optional due date (calendar day only, no time). The JSON API exposes,
filters and accepts it; the list page shows it, marks overdue todos and can show only
overdue ones.

## Goals
- `dueDate` is an optional ISO date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `DateOnly`) accepted by `POST /todos` and
  `PATCH /todos/{id}`.
- PATCH semantics for `dueDate`: field absent → unchanged; explicit `null` → due date
  removed; valid date → set/changed. (POST: absent/`null` → no due date.)
- Invalid dates — wrong format or a nonexistent day such as February 30 — are rejected
  with HTTP 400 `{"error": "..."}` on both POST and PATCH.
- `GET /todos?overdue=true` returns only overdue todos; without the parameter the full
  list is returned as before.
- Overdue = not done AND `dueDate` strictly before today, where today is computed in UTC
  (`DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow)`). A todo due today is not yet overdue.
- Todos without a date are never overdue.
- The list page shows the due date per todo (`data-testid="todo-due"`), visibly marks
  overdue ones (`data-testid="todo-overdue"`), and has a "nur überfällige" toggle
  (`data-testid="only-overdue"`) that restricts the list to overdue todos.

## Non-goals
- No time of day, no per-todo timezone.
- No stored "overdue" flag — it is computed on read and never goes stale at midnight UTC;
  the computed flag is not part of the JSON responses.
- No sorting by due date.

## Constraints
- No new NuGet packages.
- Validation errors are `ValidationException`, mapped to HTTP 400 `{"error": "..."}`;
  malformed JSON already maps to 400 via `BadHttpRequestException`.
- TDD: a failing test in `tests/` comes first.
- Every UI element tests rely on carries a `data-testid`.
- End-to-end: the agent tests the change itself in the running app with Playwright
  (see the end-to-end section in AGENTS.md); screenshots go outside the repo.

## Approaches considered
1. **Chosen** — `DateOnly? DueDate` on the `Todo` record; `NewTodo` carries the optional
   `dueDate`; `TodoPatch` distinguishes absent / `null` / value (e.g. via a `JsonElement?`
   or a small converter) so the date can also be cleared; overdue is computed where it is
   needed (`!Done && DueDate < todayUtc`). Single source of truth, cannot go stale.
2. A stored `IsOverdue` flag recomputed on every mutation — goes stale at midnight UTC.
   Rejected.
3. Storing the due date separately from the todo — splits one concept across two places.
   Rejected.

## Left to the builder
- Extend `Todo(int Id, string Title, bool Done)` with `DateOnly? DueDate`; extend `NewTodo`;
  rework `TodoPatch` so an explicit `null` clears the date while an absent field leaves it
  unchanged.
- `TodoStore.Add`/`Update` handle and validate the date; invalid dates throw
  `ValidationException` (→ 400) instead of relying on deserializer errors.
- API: `GET /todos?overdue=true` filter; verify `DateOnly` serializes as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `Home.razor`: render the date (`data-testid="todo-due"`), the overdue marker
  (`data-testid="todo-overdue"`), and the "nur überfällige" toggle
  (`data-testid="only-overdue"`) filtering the rendered list client-side.
- Tests: store tests (incl. clearing, invalid dates), API tests (filter, 400s, PATCH
  semantics), page test; then E2E in the running app with Playwright.

## Implementation Summary
**Approach** — `Todo` gained `DateOnly? DueDate`; `IsOverdue()` is a computed method on the record (not done AND due date strictly before today, today in UTC; never JSON-serialized). `TodoStore` validates dates (`yyyy-MM-dd`, invariant; anything else → `ValidationException` → HTTP 400 `{"error": ...}`) and implements PATCH semantics: absent `dueDate` keeps, explicit `null` clears, a string sets (`TodoPatch.DueDate` is a non-nullable `JsonElement` so absent/null/value are distinguishable — `JsonElement?` cannot under STJ). API: `GET /todos?overdue=true` filters to overdue todos; `dueDate` accepted on POST/PATCH. Page: `data-testid="todo-due"` ("fällig yyyy-MM-dd"), `data-testid="todo-overdue"` ("überfällig"), `data-testid="only-overdue"` checkbox filters the list. TDD throughout: failing test first per task; final suite 21/21 green; whole-branch review (subagent) came back "Ready to merge: Yes" with no Critical/Important findings.
**Consequences** — JSON responses gain `"dueDate": "YYYY-MM-DD" | null` (additive, backward compatible); new `overdue` query parameter; invalid dates → 400 on POST and PATCH.
**Possible side effects** — PATCH bodies without `dueDate` behave as before; an invalid date on a nonexistent id returns 400 before 404 (same precedence as the existing title validation).
**Watch when testing** — a todo due today (UTC) is NOT overdue; a done todo with a past date is NOT overdue; `PATCH {"dueDate": null}` clears the date. E2E status: tested by the agent in the running app with Playwright (API seed, `?overdue=true`, 400 on `2026-02-30`, marker + "nur überfällige" toggle in the UI; screenshots /tmp/e2e-todos-only-overdue.png and /tmp/e2e-todos-all.png, outside the repo).
